curated_knowledge_entries.description: Areas characterized by human settlements, buildings, transport networks, and commercial complexes with high artificial surface reflectance and strong SAR microwave double-bounce corner reflections.
curated_knowledge_entries.spectral_characteristics: High NIR reflectance in concrete roofs, high variance across optical RGB bands, SAR backscatter > -8 dB.

curated_knowledge_entries.description: Intensively cultivated land parcels showing seasonal vegetation dynamics. High NDVI values (0.4 to 0.8) during active vegetative canopy phases, transitioning to bare soil/stubble post-harvest.
curated_knowledge_entries.spectral_characteristics: High Green/NIR reflectance, low Red reflectance due to chlorophyll absorption, moderate SAR volume scattering.

curated_knowledge_entries.description: Perennial and seasonal water bodies including rivers, lakes, reservoirs, and drainage canals. High absorption in NIR/SWIR bands, negative NDWI.
curated_knowledge_entries.spectral_characteristics: Low optical reflectance (< 10%), near-zero NIR, specular SAR reflection with backscatter < -18 dB.

curated_knowledge_entries.description: Dense deciduous, evergreen, and mangrove forests exhibiting multi-layered canopy structures with high biomass volume scattering in C-band radar.
curated_knowledge_entries.spectral_characteristics: Consistent high NDVI (> 0.65), high radar cross-section volume scattering (-12 to -8 dB).

curated_knowledge_entries.description: Major urban agglomeration in the Deccan Plateau. Key geospatial landmarks include Hussain Sagar Lake, Musi River basin, and high-density IT corridor in HITEC City / Gachibowli.
Riparian flood-prone river basin along the Brahmaputra River. Experiences intense monsoon inundations between June and September, altering sandbars (chars) and agricultural boundaries.
curated_knowledge_entries.primary_sensors: Sentinel-1 SAR (all-weather flood mapping), Sentinel-2 MSI

curated_knowledge_entries.description: Central Punjab intensive agricultural hub fed by Sirhind Canal network. Dominant crop rotation of Paddy (Kharif) and Wheat (Rabi) with high seasonal surface soil moisture variation.
